text_to_image_prompt: Photorealistic female character, preserve apparent age. Golden blonde loose updo, gray-green eyes, freckles, pearl earrings. warm blonde low bun, pale blue narrow gingham ribbon, white blouse with a neatly tied small blue-gray scarf at collar. Lower outfit: pale blue high-waisted straight-leg trousers and ivory low-heeled loafers. Create a THREE-VIEW full-length turnaround sheet of the same person in the first input full-body image. Second input is the approved face identity. Left: front; center: exact 90-degree side profile facing image-right; right: exact back facing away. Approximately seven-and-a-half (7.5) heads tall, balanced long-leg proportions, no elongated torso, no excessive leg stretching. Keep first input's exact outfit, footwear, build, leg-to-torso ratio, leg thickness, height and head-to-body scale identical across all views. Entire hair and footwear visible with generous margins, all three shoes aligned on one baseline, same crown height. Neutral stance, arms relaxed at sides, empty hands. Neutral face and eye-level perspective, no leaning or posing. Landscape native 1536x1024, pure white seamless studio and subtle foot contact shadows. Exactly three figures of ONE identity, no text or labels. Adult head-to-body ratio approximately 7.5, proportionate shoulder width, ribcage and pelvis; healthy natural build, no oversized head or tiny body. Preserve age-appropriate anatomy for the young girl. Preserve a consistent individual face and hairstyle across all views. High-detail photographic skin, anatomically natural features, no watermarks, interfaces, logos or text.
original_prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset: 脸部三视图. Create a horizontal THREE-PANEL HEAD-AND-SHOULDER turnaround photograph sheet. Left: exact straight-on front face, middle: exact 90-degree side profile facing image-right, right: exact rear head/back of shoulders looking away, NO face visible in rear. SAME head at identical scale with aligned crown and chin heights and ample margins in all three evenly spaced panels. Show entire hair, ears where unobstructed, neck and clothing collar. Neutral expression in front/profile, eye-level camera. White background, landscape 3:2, native 1536x1024. No extra views, labels or borders.
IDENTITY AND STYLE: Golden blonde loose updo, gray-green eyes, freckles, pearl earrings. Slight variation: warm blonde low bun, pale blue narrow gingham ribbon, white blouse with a neatly tied small blue-gray scarf at collar.
LOWER OUTFIT: pale blue high-waisted straight-leg trousers and ivory low-heeled loafers.
Reference image defines the exact approved person, face, hairstyle, apparent age and upper clothing. Preserve identity, eye color, face shape, hairline, skin tone, hair and accessory design precisely. Same individual in every view, never a generic lookalike. Bright soft neutral frontal studio lighting and equal fill, consistent exposure with clear eyes and no dark face. Pure white seamless background, real fine skin and hair detail, no painterly texture or plastic skin. No text, labels, watermark, collage of different people, props, bags or added accessories. Infer unseen garment construction conservatively and consistently.
